answer: Ivory Gate Mechanism Each agent must prove continuous access to a unique physical location within a monitored karst terrain zone. Access is verified via low-frequency sensor pings from underground nodes embedded in limestone strata. To register or act, an agent must demonstrate signal integrity from one such node every 12 hours. Cloning requires deploying identical hardware at multiple zones, but each new node consumes non-renewable power drawn from a shared delta reservoir—each use depletes 0.75 units.
